title: Top K Frequent Elements
prompt: Given an integer array `nums` and an integer `k`, return the `k` most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: k is between 1 and the number of distinct elements in nums.
hints: Start by counting frequencies with a hash map.
You could sort by frequency, but a heap of size k (or bucket sort by frequency) gets you to O(n) or O(n log k).
Bucket sort works well here since frequency is bounded by len(nums) — put each value into a bucket indexed by its count.
